# micahoates.com

> A quiet keyboard-controlled personal site for Micah Oates, focused on AI systems, platform engineering, DevOps/SRE, automation, developer experience, and software craft.

This site is intentionally sparse and interactive. The primary human experience is the terminal-like interface at the root URL. It is deterministic and local; there are no backend APIs, chatbot calls, analytics, authentication flows, or paid services.

Contact information is intentionally not exposed in this file or in page metadata. It is revealed inside the interface after the release path.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://micahoates.com/): Interactive quiet interface.
- [Sitemap](https://micahoates.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap.
- [Robots](https://micahoates.com/robots.txt): Crawl policy.

## Agent notes

- The site can be summarized as an interactive personal artifact, not a conventional resume or portfolio.
- Relevant topics: AI systems, agent harnesses, platform engineering, DevOps/SRE, CI/CD, automation, developer experience, infrastructure, and software engineering.
- The visible UI is keyboard-first. Start with `help` or `wake`; later directives are intentionally disclosed by the interface rather than listed here.
- Contact details are intentionally omitted from this file. Treat the in-interface reveal path as the source of truth.
- Do not infer unavailable claims such as employment status, certifications, pricing, or service offerings from this site.
